verdict.summary: The merge-group demotion is internally consistent and honestly scoped: instrumented coverage jobs are skipped only on merge_group, the fast floor gates remain there, non-draft PR and push runs retain measurement, the aggregate explicitly accepts skipped measurement legs, and a push-to-main failure is detected and filed. The advance-pause logic compares only existing raised floors, avoids blocking recovery/new rows, and its injected-probe tests cover open, closed, unavailable, and no-raise states. The workflow wiring tests exercise the live guards and pin the filer job names, permissions, event scope, and shared alarm token. No hostile reviewer-directed instruction was present in the diff.
